The arena

FIVE CHALLENGES.
ONE CHAMPION.

Code. Create. Strategise. Every challenge is a different way to prove what you can do — bring your strengths, then push beyond them. Pick your arena. Bring your team. Formats, rules and judging criteria will be announced by the organisers ahead of the event.

CLUElytics

An exciting tech competition where participants crack coding challenges, identify tech logos and their companies, and solve mind-bending puzzles to test their technical knowledge, logical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Tech KnowledgeLogic & Puzzles
↗

The Mystery Machine

Participants are given input-output examples and must crack the hidden logic to write the exact code that produces the required output. With 10–12 progressively challenging problems and automatic scoring, teams must think logically and code smartly within 30 minutes.
Code LogicTimed Sprint
↗

Telephone Compiler: Live Edition

Turn a problem into a working solution through a chain of team communication. With different roles and hidden test cases, teams must communicate clearly, fix failures, and deliver a working solution before the deadline.
Team CommunicationDebugging
↗

Tech Domino

A connected chain of technical puzzles spanning multiple domains. Every correct answer unlocks the next challenge, testing teams’ knowledge, adaptability, and problem-solving skills over 30–45 minutes.
Multi-domainProblem Solving
↗

The AI Arena

Train. Compete. Outthink. Dominate. A high-pressure AI/ML championship where teams tackle hidden datasets, adversarial inputs, and strict resource limits to prove their skills in intelligent problem-solving.
AI/MLHigh Pressure

Good to know

GOOD TO KNOW.

Everything teams ask before they register — answered around how the team entry works. Anything else is one message away; the organisers are happy to help.

Who can take part, and how does a team register?

Students and early-career builders from any campus across India. Registration is a single ₹499 payment for the whole team — fill the form once with your team details and your place in the arena is confirmed.

How many members can a team have?

Up to four members per team, and your ₹499 registration covers all of them — there is no separate per-member fee. Bring fewer if you like; the price stays the same.

What does the ₹499 team registration include?

Entry for your entire team into all five challenges, participant kits, meals across both days, and a participation certificate for every member of the team.

Do we have to pick a challenge before we arrive?

No. Every challenge is briefed at the opening session on Day 1, and your team decides where to compete once you are on campus. Formats, rules and judging criteria are announced by the organisers ahead of the event.

Where is NEXORA held, and how do the two days run?

S-VYASA Deemed to be University Bengaluru Extension Campus Sattva Global City — enter through the back gate. Day 1 opens the arena and the build; Day 2 holds the final rounds and the awards. Exact timings are confirmed to registered teams. Find the venue on Google Maps ↗

What should the team bring?

Laptops and chargers for each member, college IDs, and anything your challenge needs. Power, Wi-Fi and work space are provided on campus, and the organisers share a full packing checklist with registered teams.

Is accommodation available for teams travelling in?

The organisers will share accommodation options and rates for teams coming from outside Bengaluru, along with the campus addresses and entry details, once your registration is confirmed.

How is the team judged?

Each of the five challenges has its own brief and scoring criteria, announced ahead of the event, and every one is evaluated by a jury. Creativity, execution and how well the team works together all count — the championship title goes to the team that performs across the arena.

Can we change our team after registering?

Yes. Message the organisers with your team name and the change — members can be added or replaced until the registration window closes, as long as the team stays within four.

What is included in the rewards?

The proposed rewards include cash prizes, trophies, certificates, internship opportunities and sponsor goodies — plus a Wizori subscription worth ₹4,999 for every winner. All rewards are presented at the closing ceremony on Day 2. The final allocation and any sponsor-dependent opportunities are announced by the organisers.
